batch: playtest round 12: the Trees ATL sign moved to Monroe and built right, plus an audit guard
share: /Volumes/Adam Assets/Unreal/Builds/Share/The Battle of ATL Mac Playtest 114

what_changed.ask: maybe there is a sign that says please keep off the grass at monroe before you get to the beltline and it says - Trees ATL working on the grass please keep off
what_changed.what: ABattleGrassSign now places itself on the park side of the route, about 85 m short of the MonroeCrossing-tagged crossing on the line the rider rides in on. It snaps to the nearest APiedmontPathSpline (200 cm steps) and offsets half-width + 180 cm to the roadside, then ground-traces. Fallback to the old gate-relative placement is retained. Before: the sign spawned 90 m from BattleHomeData::Gate at Krog/Cabbagetown, which is the wrong end of the whole route.

what_changed.bug: the board was rendering as a sliver floating 2.8 m above the post
what_changed.cause: Post was the actor root and carried a non-uniform scale (0.14, 0.14, 2.0). Board was a child of Post, so it inherited that scale and a 140 cm local Z offset.
what_changed.fix: a plain USceneComponent Root is now the actor root; Post and Board are both children of Root, so the board is a true 6 x 150 x 90 cm panel sitting on the post.

what_changed.what: the grass audit now asserts the sign exists, its SignBoard measures about 6 x 150 x 90 cm, and the sign stands within 600 cm of a route spline. The audit fails with a specific reason if any of those is untrue.

rendered_proof.shows: the TREES ATL board standing on its post beside the route on the way to Monroe, reading TREES ATL / WORKING ON THE GRASS / PLEASE KEEP OFF
